title: Identify tote presence at sorter rack locations using rack color (dark blue vs light blue) in RMS/map view
summary: Use the RMS/map view rack color coding to determine whether a sorter rack location is showing a tote present (dark blue/violet) or empty (light blue). This is especially useful when a tote is expected at a sorter destination but the map does not show the expected logical tote.
when_to_use: When you need to quickly confirm whether RMS/map believes a tote is present at a specific sorter rack location by interpreting the rack’s color tone (dark blue/violet vs light blue), particularly when a tote is expected at a sorter destination but the map does not show a logical tote.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Perform the RMS/map rack color check for the specific rack location and report whether the rack is indicating tote present (dark blue/violet) or empty (light blue).

system_preconditions: RMS/map view is displaying rack locations with the dark blue/violet vs light blue color tones

visual_references.description: RMS/map rack locations showing the two distinct rack color tones: dark blue (almost like violet) vs light blue, and the meaning of each for tote presence vs empty.

steps.title: Locate the rack location in RMS/map view
steps.purpose: Identify the specific rack location whose tote presence state you need to confirm.
steps.instruction: In the RMS/map view, locate the rack location you want to check.
steps.expected_result: You have identified the target rack location on the RMS/map view.
steps.healthy_condition: The target rack location is visible on the RMS/map view and can be visually distinguished as a rack location.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot reliably identify the intended rack location on the map (wrong location selected or unclear rack boundary).

actions.label: Find rack location on map
actions.exact_action: Locate the rack location you want to check in the RMS/map view.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “What are these These are rack locations, right …”

steps.title: Interpret rack color tone to determine tote presence vs empty
steps.purpose: Determine whether the rack location is indicating tote present or empty based on the documented color mapping.
steps.instruction: Observe the rack’s color tone in the RMS/map view: dark blue (almost like violet) vs light blue. Use the color meaning to classify the rack as tote present or empty.
steps.expected_result: You can state the rack’s tote presence state: dark blue/violet = tote present; light blue = empty.
steps.healthy_condition: The rack shows one of the two distinct tones described: dark blue (tote present) or light blue (empty).
steps.failure_condition: The rack color tone does not match the expected tote presence for the destination you are investigating.

actions.label: Check rack color tone
actions.exact_action: Observe the rack’s color tone: dark blue (almost like violet) vs light blue.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the rack color does not match the expected tote presence for the destination, stop and escalate for further investigation (the source notes this can indicate an issue with tote addition/removal).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “If a rack has this dark blue tone, it means it has a tote on it. If it has the light blue toad, it means it's empty.”
“There are two distinct color … dark blue almost like a Violet … If a rack has this dark blue tone, it means it has a toad on it. … light blue … means it's empty.”
“And that is very helpful when you're looking at a sorter destination where … you expect to see a toad there … You see that as a light blue.”

steps.title: Use the color evidence when a tote is expected at a sorter destination but not shown logically
steps.purpose: Apply the rack color interpretation to the troubleshooting context: expected tote vs what RMS/map is showing.
steps.instruction: If you expect a tote at a sorter destination but RMS/map does not show a logical tote, use the rack color evidence to conclude whether RMS/map believes the rack is empty (light blue) or has a tote (dark blue/violet).
steps.expected_result: Your conclusion aligns with the rack color: light blue supports “empty” while dark blue/violet supports “tote present.”
steps.healthy_condition: The rack color interpretation provides a consistent explanation for why the expected tote is (or is not) shown logically at the sorter destination.
steps.failure_condition: RMS/map shows a rack color that contradicts the expected tote presence for the destination, suggesting a tote addition/removal issue.

actions.label: Apply rack color meaning to destination expectation
actions.exact_action: Use the rack’s dark blue/violet vs light blue tone to determine tote present vs empty for the sorter destination.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the rack color does not match the expected tote presence for the destination, stop and escalate for further investigation (tote addition process not getting added properly).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “And that is very helpful when you're looking at a sorter destination where … you expect to see a toad there, but maybe someone … removed the wrong tote. You … see that as a light blue … Wait, we're supposed to have a tote here? … on the RMS, you don't ever see that rag go from light blue to dark blue. So … there's something wrong in the tote addition process and it's not getting added properly.”

success_criteria: You correctly classify the rack location as tote present (dark blue/violet) or empty (light blue) using the RMS/map rack color tone.
healthy_conditions: RMS/map rack locations show the two distinct tones (dark blue/violet and light blue) and the interpretation is applied consistently to the target rack location.
failure_conditions: The rack color tone contradicts the expected tote presence for the sorter destination (e.g., expected tote but rack appears light blue/empty).
escalation_guidance: If the rack color does not match the expected tote presence for the destination, stop and escalate for further investigation of the tote addition/removal process (source notes this can indicate the tote addition process is not getting added properly).

screens_or_images.description: RMS/map rack locations color meaning: dark blue/violet = tote present; light blue = empty.

missing_details: The packet does not provide the specific escalation path/contacts or the next diagnostic actions beyond stopping and escalating when the rack color contradicts expectations.
